defs.def: the substance that looks like a mass of fine threads growing especially on the head; one of these threads growing on the body of people and some animals 毛发；（尤指）头发

ex.s: She would speed up, the wind blowing our hair back _____64_____ my tiny voice singing out, “Weeee-eee-eee!”
ex.t: 她会加快速度，风吹得我们的头发向后飘，而我小小的声音唱着："哇——哦——哦——哦！"

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母在椅子上小睡醒来，用手指捋了捋花白的卷发，望着窗外的蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: Last Friday my mom decided to color his hair.
ex.t: 上周五我妈妈决定染头发。

ex.s: The color she choose came in a box which had a picture of a woman that hair color looked just perfect.
ex.t: 她选的颜色装在一个盒子里，盒子上有一张女人的图片，那头发颜色看起来棒极了。

ex.s: She put the new color on her hair or sat still for 30 minutes, just as the directions saying.
ex.t: 她把染发剂涂在头发上，然后静坐了30分钟，就像说明书上写的那样。

ex.s: However, instead of the brownish red hair she had hoped for, she final got purple hair.
ex.t: 然而，她最终得到的不是她希望的红棕色头发，而是紫色的头发。

ex.s: My classmates ranged from those kids with pale skin and large blue eyes to those with rich brown skin and dark hair.
ex.t: 我的同学从皮肤苍白、蓝眼睛的孩子到深棕色皮肤、黑头发的孩子都有。

ex.s: Sometimes I think no matter where we come from, what colour our eyes, hair and skin, we are here to show our understanding and help.
ex.t: 有时我想，无论我们来自哪里，无论眼睛、头发和皮肤是什么颜色，我们来到这里都是为了表达理解并提供帮助。

ex.s: No, this is for setting my hair yesterday.''
ex.t: 不，这是昨天给我做头发（做造型）用的。

ex.s: In those days , a brush was made from camel’s hair.
ex.t: 在那个时候，画笔是用骆驼毛制成的。

ex.s: Benjamin decided that cat hair would work instead.
ex.t: 本杰明决定用猫毛代替。

ex.s: In his thirties, he was quite thin and pale, and he had red, bushy hair.
ex.t: 他三十多岁时相当瘦削苍白，有一头浓密的红发。

ex.s: Strangely, his beard is still red even though his hair is turning grey!
ex.t: 奇怪的是，尽管他的头发正在变成灰色，他的胡子仍然是红色的！

ex.s: She still has smooth skin and straight black hair, and jogging has kept her slim and fit.
ex.t: 她仍然有光滑的皮肤和黑色直发，慢跑使她保持苗条和健康。

ex.s: I still have light skin and black hair, of course.
ex.t: 我当然还是浅色皮肤和黑头发。

defs.def: having the type of hair mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: She studied with all the hair products at the drugstore.
ex.t: 她在药店里研究了所有的染发产品。

ex.s: To many people, ___59____lives is part of the job but styling hair is an ___60____ and should be rewarded.
ex.t: 对许多人来说，___59___生活是工作的一部分，但做发型是一种___60___，应该得到回报。

ex.s: Meng Hao’s feelings excited: woke up early; rushed out of the door ____________________________ ____________________________ ____________________________ 1 I saw a white-haired man.
ex.t: 孟浩的感受：兴奋——起得很早；冲出家门……我看到一个白发男人。

defs.def: a thing that looks like a fine thread growing on the leaves and stems of some plants （植物叶茎上的）茸毛
